args.question: What is the exact formula for "data risk"? Is it the same as CDVR (Cross-Border Data Volume Risk = CBRF × VolGB), or is it a different calculation? Also, should "flow ID" refer to dataflow.recordregistry or dataflow.flowtag?

result: The "data risk" is calculated as `(RiskAssess / CtrlEff) * CASE WHEN OrigNation != DestNation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END`. This is then multiplied by `VolGB` to get the CDVR. The "flow ID" refers to `dataflow.recordregistry`.

content: What is the exact formula for "data risk"? Is it the same as CDVR (Cross-Border Data Volume Risk = CBRF × VolGB), or is it a different calculation? Also, should "flow ID" refer to dataflow.recordregistry or dataflow.flowtag?

args.sql:
SELECT 
    df.recordregistry AS flow_id,
    rm.riskassess,
    rm.ctrleff,
    df.orignation,
    df.destnation,
    dp.volgb,
    (rm.riskassess / rm.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN df.orignation != df.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS data_risk,
    (rm.riskassess / rm.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN df.orignation != df.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * dp.volgb AS cdvr
FROM dataflow df
JOIN dataprofile dp ON df.recordregistry = dp.flowsign
JOIN riskmanagement rm ON df.flowlink = df.recordregistry
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    df.recordregistry AS flow_id,
    ROUND(CAST((rm.riskassess / rm.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN df.orignation != df.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS numeric), 4) AS cross_border_risk_factor,
    ROUND(CAST((rm.riskassess / rm.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN df.orignation != df.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS numeric), 4) AS data_risk,
    ROUND(CAST(((rm.riskassess / rm.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN df.orignation != df.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * dp.volgb AS numeric), 4) AS cdvr,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ((rm.riskassess / rm.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN df.orignation != df.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * dp.volgb) DESC) AS rank
FROM dataflow df
JOIN dataprofile dp ON df.recordregistry = dp.flowsign
JOIN riskmanagement rm ON rm.flowlink = df.recordregistry
WHERE ((rm.riskassess / rm.ctrleff) * CASE WHEN df.orignation != df.destnation THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * dp.volgb) > 1000
ORDER BY cdvr DESC
LIMIT 5;
